## Fun Raiser — Mare Fair mascot

[![Fun Raiser, official Mare Fair artwork by TheBatFang](https://marefair.org/_astro/FR.BZfOSFIW_Xqw6F.png)](https://marefair.org/scrapbook/)

*Art: TheBatFang (credited in Mare Fair’s official scrapbook).*

Fun Raiser is Mare Fair’s upbeat unicorn helper: she connects ponies who need something with others who can provide it. She is also an unexpectedly talented bartender nicknamed *Bar Mare*—a nickname, not a separate identity. This is the fan convention’s own character and storytelling continuity, not a character established in Hasbro’s *Friendship is Magic* episodes. See the [official mascot biography](https://marefair.org/mascots/).

*Appearance:* Pale yellow-green coat, enormous curled orange-and-peach mane and tail, teal eyes, and a unicorn horn. She wears round glasses and a white blouse with a green-and-gold clasp in the pictured design; her cutie mark shows a building and palm tree.

*Name and voice:* “Fun Raiser” is the convention’s own name, documented by its 2025 animated introduction, rather than a fan-assigned background-pony name. No earlier name is verified. She speaks and sings: *PrinceWhateverer* is credited as her voice in a 2026 PSA and as her singer in the 2025 and [2026 opening animation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U3WDt-4kr0o).

- **Meet the newest mascot** — *Mare Fair 2025 Opening Ceremony Animation* (2025; no TV season/episode): [official video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DE4XKzipQLo), timestamp unavailable. The animation introduces Fun Raiser to the convention’s cast.
- **Catching up on convention history** — *Fair Flyer’s Photo Album!* (2026; no TV season/episode): [official video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EJ183AEgVgo), timestamp unavailable. Fair Flyer shares earlier Mare Fair memories with the newcomer.
- **Looking after partygoers** — *Drink Responsibly! — A Mare Fair PSA* (2026; no TV season/episode): [official video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dlmTcaaa1EA), timestamp unavailable. Fun Raiser leads the responsible-drinking advice, showing the caring side of her party persona.
